scope: Packaged-window Build smoke for Orbit Code through tauri-driver/WebDriver. Default mode verifies readiness; live Build requires ORBIT_DESKTOP_BUILD_LIVE=1.

criteria.label: Orbit Code debug/release binary exists.
criteria.message: Found a launchable Orbit Code binary.

criteria.label: Live Build smoke seeds a non-secret DeepSeek session.
criteria.message: Seeded provider/model selection into the temporary encrypted Orbit database; provider credential remains in the vault envelope.

criteria.label: WebDriver can launch an Orbit Code desktop session.
criteria.message: tauri-driver created a WRY session for Orbit Code.

criteria.label: Workbench shell is visible in the real Tauri window.
criteria.message: The launched desktop window rendered Orbit Code's workbench shell.

criteria.label: Live Build smoke uses an isolated workspace.
criteria.message: Prepared a temporary workspace and removed stale smoke output before launching Build.

criteria.label: Packaged desktop window loads the isolated smoke workspace.
criteria.message: The workbench rendered the smoke workspace after seeding Orbit's active workspace storage.

criteria.label: Live Build smoke dispatches the prompt through the packaged desktop window.
criteria.message: The smoke prompt was submitted to the packaged workbench before waiting for approval.

criteria.label: Build produces a real approval request.
criteria.message: Approval overlay appeared in the packaged desktop window.

criteria.label: Build approval resolution is submitted from the packaged window.
criteria.message: The packaged window accepted the approval button action.

criteria.label: Denied approval does not produce terminal output or file edits.
criteria.message: The packaged window reflected denial without terminal/fileEdit artifacts.

criteria.label: Live Build smoke cleans the temporary file it asks Codex to write.
criteria.message: No smoke file was present after the run.
